title: tabernaemontana hoabinhensis
intro: Tabernaemontana hoabinhensis, commonly known as the Hoabinh Tabernaemontana, is a species of plant in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its traditional use in folk medicine in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases and conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana hoabinhensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, such as voacangine and voacristine, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antitumor, and neuroprotective activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential applications of Tabernaemontana hoabinhensis.
